name: Sling Bullets
operation_language: Authoring intent only; not registered engine syntax.

rules.text: Purchase lot: 20 Sling Bullets, weight 1.5 pounds, cost 0.04 GP. Typical storage is separate. A weapon with Ammunition needs the declared type and spends one piece on each attack. Drawing is part of attack, with a free hand to load a one-handed weapon; one minute after a fight recovers half used, rounded down.
